title: Page 4
slug: 良膳小娘子下-子纹-面对偏心偏到天边去的家人赵小丫这世学聪明了-被当奴婢使唤嫁给傻子换银子的烂事绝不会再发生-娘亲与姊姊
lines: 赵小丫是认得卫元召的，当今卫阁老的嫡长子，京城第一大才子，年纪轻轻已是五品户部郎中，将来还会迎娶恭亲王的掌上明珠，是个前途不可限量的人物。
“卫公子，我姓赵，叫小丫。”
卫元召眨了下眼，怀疑自己听错，“赵小丫？”他不确定的重复一次，“姓赵，名小丫？”
赵小丫看着卫元召的神情，有些不好意思的红了脸。这名字确实取得随便，但她早有一套自我安慰的法子，至少不重视她的赵家还能给她个名字，已经是万幸。
“嗯。”赵小丫轻应了声，好脾气的露出一抹笑，“姓赵，名小丫，赵小丫。”
卫元召忍不住仰头大笑，“这名字真逗。”
周屹天皱眉看着卫元召，不悦的神情轻易可见，压根忘了自己第一次听到赵小丫的名字时也是一脸耻笑。
卫元召丝毫没有理会周屹天，径自盯着赵小丫和善的笑脸，心生好感。
虽是瘦了点，但五官清秀，不敢说长开后会成倾国倾城的大美人，不过肯定不会差。
“你这酒涡挺好的，跟我一样。”卫元召一压自己的右脸颊，他不单笑起来有酒涡，与她一样，双眼也会眯得像月牙儿。“我也有。”
赵小丫看着他孩子气的举动，笑得更开。她在看到卫元召第一眼便打定主意要交好，毕竟她知晓上辈子卫元召为了周屹天在朝廷之上舌战群雄，压得一票原对周屹天手刃降军多有微词的文官毫无还口之力，就知两人交情深厚。
“这世上笑起来有酒涡的人多了。”周屹天冷着脸说道：“你每见一个都要拉上关系不成？”
“我可并非人人皆好。”卫元召等着店小二上完茶具退下，之后才一副自来熟的模样继续说道：“今日是看小丫投缘。”
周屹天的嘴不屑的一撇，漠北有乱，自己离京在即，担心小丫一人在京城无人照料，想将她托付给可信之人，这才找来这家伙。
卫府与昆阳侯府两家相近，他与卫元召年纪相当，虽一文一武，却气味相投，从小到大偷鸡摸狗的事两人没少做。
凭着这分自小长大的情谊，将小丫托付给他自然是最好。
但看着笑得开怀的卫元召，他心中不快。
卫元召没理会周屹天的不快，目光落在赵小丫身上，眼底满是兴趣。
没料到初初一眼并不起眼的丫头，竟会因泡茶的动作和娴雅的神情令他看迷了眼。
周屹天眼神透露警告，“跟别人的媳妇投缘，这可不好。”
卫元召眨了下眼，媳妇？他看向赵小丫，丫头看起来很娇小，年纪应该不大。
“你成亲了？”
赵小丫一脸困惑，抬头看着周屹天。
“我姥爷替我定下的。”
周屹天脸不红气不喘的拉起赵小丫的手，露出手腕上的兽牙手串。
赵小丫闻言脸蓦然一红，连忙缩回自己的手，给两人斟茶。
卫元召没见过顾乔成，但对于这位顾副将过往在战场上的英勇事蹟却知之甚详，只是他早已卸甲归田多年，在京城没半点消息，没料到会突然帮周屹天找了个媳妇。
只是姓赵……他将京城可以称得上名号的人家想了个遍，没有一户姓赵。
“小丫不是京城人士？”
赵小丫摇头，老实回答，“我来自光州的山村。”
她没因自己的身分感到丢人，毕竟这是事实，改变不了。
卫元召没有一丝看不起，反而轻笑，“没想到咱们真是有缘，光州出美人儿，我娘亲便出身光州。”
赵小丫闻言微惊，这还真是巧了，正想开口问，周屹天却拿着手中的杯子碰了碰卫元召面前的茶，“光州占地广大，少攀关系。”
卫元召忍着笑意喝了一口，入口甘甜，他的眼睛一亮，“太白楼的菜不怎么样，茶倒是还成。”
“茶只要好水、好茶叶，掌握泡茶的时间，口感便不会差。”赵小丫开了口，“但饭菜不同。”
“听你的口气，你厨艺应当不差。”
赵小丫温柔的眼眸满是笑意，附在周屹天的耳边轻语了几句。
周屹天先是皱眉，等赵小丫说完，这才神情稍霁，点了点头赵小丫起身对卫元召一福，“卫公子，先告退。”
“等——我还没跟你聊完，你怎么就她要去给我弄饭菜。”周屹天打断了卫元召的话，“她说空腹喝茶，怕伤了我的身子。”
卫元召闻言啧啧几声，“你是想告诉我，我今日是沾你的光才有口福是吧？”
周屹天没说话，但神情已给了答案。
卫元召也没恼，只是实事求事的说道：“赵姑娘虽然举止算是进退得宜，但还是一眼就能看出并非大家出身。你姥爷给你挑的这门亲事，暂时还看不出是好是坏。”
“只要我喜欢就是好的。”
卫元召的眼底一亮，他就是欣赏周屹天这种没来由的自信。
他爹虽已身居高位，但卫家并非世家，祖上世代为农，难得出了他爹这么个大才子，八岁考上童生，十三岁成秀才，十六岁便三元及第，进京之后深受先皇重用，在太子登基后一步步走到今日的位置，成为当朝大儒，杏林满天下。
然而他幼年时，因爹的官职不高，在这个满是权贵的京城，被人欺负是平常，只不过眼前这位在外人眼中看来蛮横的昆阳侯府大少爷始终对他多有维护。
其实他看得出周屹天并非多喜欢当时瘦弱的他，只不过是天性使然，看不惯别人无来由的欺侮弱小罢了。
他还记得爹曾经对周屹天做下论断——正义凛然之人，不为恶人。
有了这句话，他决定将周屹天视为好友，这么些年过去，这人也没让他失望。
“看来你是认定了。”卫元召是个聪明人，一想便明白，“你今日特意寻我来，是要我替你多看顾她？”
周屹天不客气的直言，“漠北有乱，魏将军已请旨，只等圣上下旨便会带兵前往。”
卫元召沉默了一会儿，如今昆阳侯醉心佛法，不问世事，侯府这么些年俨然已是二房当家，周屹天若不思改变，守着徒有虚名的侯府，将来也只会沦为二房的俎上肉。
“我明白了。”
“明白便好。”周屹天目光如炬的看着卫元召，“我记得你有个未过门的妻室，应知朋友妻不可戏。”
卫元召不屑的扫了他一眼，“我可没你这般禽兽，小姑娘才多大年纪。”
周屹天没好气的看着他，“已是及笄之年。”
“还真看不出已到成亲的年岁。”卫元召回想赵小丫巴掌大的小脸，“看来她以前的日子不好过。”
周屹天不愿多提赵小丫的过去，赵家人运气好，顾乔成死了，他带着赵小丫返京，不然他要做的可不单单偷光他们全家这么简单。
“对了，拿去。”卫元召掏出衣襟里的纸。
周屹天接过来
“圣上给的。”卫元召原话带到，“给你的护卫队赐名。”
周屹天撇了下嘴，他养私军的事没瞒着圣上，他们两人算是不打不相识，从小打到大，圣上从来没打赢过，就只会在一些小处宣示自己的优越，彰显身分，讨回面子。
“他已是当今圣上，我不会动手打他了。”周屹天将纸放到一旁，言下之意是不用再搞这些小东西，不过就是两个字，还要他谢恩不成？
“等有机会，你自个儿跟他提吧。”卫元召才不想插手这两人的事，面上周屹天与当今圣上并没有交集，但身为他们中间的传话者，卫元召深知两人可谓交情匪浅。
content_en:
Zhao Xiaoya knew Wei Yuanzhao. He was the eldest son of Mr. Wei Ge and the most talented man in the capital. At a young age, he was already a fifth-grade household doctor. He would also marry Prince Gong's daughter in the future. He was a man with an unlimited future.
"Mr. Wei, my surname is Zhao and my name is Xiaoya."
Wei Yuanzhao blinked, suspecting that he heard correctly, "Zhao Xiaoya?" He repeated uncertainly, "The surname is Zhao, the name is Xiaoya?"
Zhao Xiaoya looked at Wei Yuanzhao's expression and blushed with embarrassment. The name was indeed chosen casually, but she already had a way to comfort herself. At least the Zhao family, which didn't take her seriously, could still give her a name, which was a blessing.
"Yes." Zhao Xiaoya responded softly, smiling good-naturedly, "The surname is Zhao, the name is Xiaoya, Zhao Xiaoya."
Wei Yuanzhao couldn't help but throw his head back and laugh, "This name is really funny."
Zhou Yitian frowned and looked at Wei Yuanzhao, his displeasure easily visible. He had completely forgotten that he had also smiled with ridicule when he heard Zhao Xiaoya's name for the first time.
Wei Yuanzhao ignored Zhou Yitian at all and stared at Zhao Xiaoya's kind smiling face, feeling fond of him.
Although she is a bit thinner, her facial features are delicate. I can’t say that she will become a beauty that will captivate the whole country when she grows taller, but she will definitely not be bad.
"You have pretty good dimples, just like me." Wei Yuanzhao pressed his right cheek. Not only did he smile with dimples, but like her, his eyes also narrowed like crescent moons. "Me too."
Zhao Xiaoya smiled even wider when she saw his childish behavior. She had made up her mind to be friends with Wei Yuanzhao at the first sight. After all, she knew that in her previous life, Wei Yuanzhao had fought with everyone in the court for Zhou Yitian, and had won a lot of votes from the civil servants who had criticized Zhou Yitian for killing the army. She knew that the two had a deep friendship.
"There are a lot of people in the world who look like they are drunk when they smile." Zhou Yitian said with a cold face, "Don't you want to get in touch with every one you meet?"
"I'm not a good person for everyone." Wei Yuanzhao waited for the waiter to finish loading the tea set and then left, then continued with a familiar look: "Today is to see Xiaoya fall in love."
Zhou Yitian curled his lips disdainfully, there was chaos in Mobei, and he was about to leave the capital. He was worried that Xiaoya would have no one to take care of her in the capital, so he wanted to entrust her to a trustworthy person, so he found this guy.
The Wei Mansion and the Kunyang Hou Mansion were close to each other. He and Wei Yuanzhao were about the same age. Although they were both civilized and military, they had similar temperaments. The two of them had done a lot of stealing and poaching since they were young.
With this friendship that has grown up since childhood, it is naturally best to entrust Xiaoya to him.
But looking at Wei Yuanzhao who was smiling heartily, he felt unhappy.
Wei Yuanzhao ignored Zhou Yitian's displeasure, and his eyes fell on Zhao Xiaoya, his eyes full of interest.
He didn't expect that the girl, who seemed unremarkable at first glance, would be fascinated by her actions of making tea and her elegant expression.
Zhou Yitian's eyes warned, "It's not good to fall in love with someone else's wife."
Wei Yuanzhao blinked, wife? He looked at Zhao Xiaoya. The girl looked very petite, probably not very old.
"Are you married?"
Zhao Xiaoya looked up at Zhou Yitian with confusion on her face.
"My grandpa decided it for me."
Zhou Yitian, without blushing or out of breath, took Zhao Xiaoya's hand and revealed the animal tooth bracelet on his wrist.
Zhao Xiaoya's face suddenly turned red when she heard this, and she quickly retracted her hand and poured tea for the two of them.
Wei Yuanzhao had never met Gu Qiaocheng, but he knew very well about Vice Admiral Gu's heroic deeds on the battlefield in the past. However, he had been disarmed and returned to his field for many years and had no news in the capital. He did not expect that he would suddenly find a wife for Zhou Yitian.
It's just that the surname is Zhao... He thought about all the families in the capital who could be named, and there was no one with the surname Zhao.
"Xiaoya is not from the capital?"
Zhao Xiaoya shook his head and answered honestly, "I'm from a mountain village in Guangzhou."
She didn't feel ashamed because of her identity. After all, it was a fact and couldn't be changed.
Wei Yuanzhao didn't look down on her at all, but chuckled, "I didn't expect that we are really destined. Guangzhou produces beauties, and my mother was born in Guangzhou."
Zhao Xiaoya was slightly shocked when he heard this. What a coincidence. Just when he was about to ask, Zhou Yitian touched the tea in front of Wei Yuanzhao with the cup in his hand, "Guangzhou occupies a vast area, so there are few connections."
Wei Yuanzhao held back his smile and took a sip. It tasted sweet and his eyes lit up. "The food at Taibailou is not that good, but the tea is okay."
"As long as tea has good water and tea leaves, and you know the brewing time, the taste will not be bad." Zhao Xiaoya said, "But the food is different."
"From your tone, your cooking skills should be pretty good."
Zhao Xiaoya's gentle eyes were full of smiles, and she whispered a few words into Zhou Yitian's ear.
Zhou Yitian frowned at first. After Zhao Xiaoya finished speaking, his expression brightened slightly and he nodded. Zhao Xiaoya stood up and called Wei Yuan, "Mr. Wei, please leave first."
"Wait - I haven't finished talking to you yet, why do you ask her to go get me some food?" Zhou Yitian interrupted Wei Yuanzhao, "She said she drank tea on an empty stomach because she was afraid of hurting my body."
Wei Yuanzhao clicked his tongue a few times when he heard this, "You want to tell me that I am lucky today because of your glory, right?"
Zhou Yitian said nothing, but his expression gave him the answer.
Wei Yuanzhao was not annoyed, and just said in a matter-of-fact manner: "Although Miss Zhao behaves appropriately, she can still tell at a glance that she is not from the same family. The marriage your grandpa has chosen for you is not yet clear whether it is good or bad."
"As long as I like it, it's fine."
Wei Yuanzhao's eyes lit up, he just admired Zhou Yitian's unwarranted confidence.
Although his father was already in a high position, the Wei family was not an aristocratic family. His ancestors had been farmers for generations, so it was rare for his father to be such a great talent. He was admitted as a boy student at the age of eight, became a scholar at the age of thirteen, and passed the third grade at the age of sixteen. After entering the capital, he was highly valued by the late emperor. After the crown prince ascended the throne, he gradually reached his current position, becoming a great scholar in the dynasty, with apricot trees all over the world.
However, when he was young, because his father's official position was not high, it was common for him to be bullied in this capital city full of powerful people. However, the young master of the Kunyang Hou Mansion in front of him, who seemed arrogant to outsiders, was always very protective of him.
In fact, he could tell that Zhou Yitian didn't really like him when he was thin at the time. It was just his nature and he couldn't stand others bullying the weak for no reason.
He still remembered that his father once made a judgment about Zhou Yitian - a righteous person cannot be a villain.
With these words, he decided to regard Zhou Yitian as a good friend. After all these years, this man has not let him down.
"It seems that you have made up your mind." Wei Yuanzhao is a smart man and he understood immediately, "You came specifically to find me today because you want me to take care of her for you?"
Zhou Yitian bluntly said, "There is chaos in Mobei. General Wei has asked for an order. He will lead his troops there as soon as the emperor issues an order."
Wei Yuanzhao was silent for a while. Now Kunyang Hou is obsessed with Buddhism and does not care about worldly affairs. The Hou Mansion has become the head of the second house in these years. If Zhou Yitian does not want to change and guards the Hou Mansion in vain, he will only become the second house's slave in the future.
"I understand."
"As long as you understand." Zhou Yitian looked at Wei Yuanzhao with burning eyes, "I remember that you have an unmarried wife. You should know that you are not allowed to play with your friends' wives."
Wei Yuanzhao glanced at him disdainfully, "I'm not a beast like you. How old is this little girl?"
Zhou Yitian looked at him angrily, "You are already in your late teens."
"I really can't tell that I'm old enough to get married." Wei Yuan recalled thinking about Zhao Xiaoya's palm-sized face, "It seems like she had a hard time in the past."
Zhou Yitian didn't want to mention Zhao Xiaoya's past. The Zhao family was lucky. Gu Qiaocheng died and he took Zhao Xiaoya back to Beijing. Otherwise, he would have to do more than just steal their whole family.
"By the way, take it." Wei Yuanzhao took out the paper from his lapel.
Zhou Yitian took it over
"Given by the Holy One," Wei Yuanzhao said, "give a name to your escort."
Zhou Yitian curled his lips. He did not hide his private army from His Majesty. The two of them had never known each other before. Ever since they were young, His Majesty had never won a fight. He would only declare his superiority in small ways, show off his status, and save face.
"He is now the Holy Emperor. I won't hit him anymore." Zhou Yitian put the paper aside. The implication was that there was no need to deal with these little things anymore. It was just two words. Do you still want him to thank you?
"When you get the chance, you can mention it to him yourself." Wei Yuanzhao didn't want to get involved in the affairs of these two people. In front of him, Zhou Yitian had no contact with the current emperor, but as the messenger between them, Wei Yuanzhao knew that the two had a close friendship.
